articles.title: Implementation of Single-Pill Combination Therapy Through Team-Based Care for Hypertension Control in Resource-Constrained Settings: A Cluster Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Lopez-Lopez JP, Duncan J, Chen J, Mills KT, Ferguson T, Reyes M, Lanza P, Geng S, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Single-pill combination therapy improves medication adherence and hypertension control. However, limited evidence is available on its implementation in routine clinical practice.
abstract.textZh: 單一藥丸聯合治療可改善藥物依從性和高血壓控制。然而，在常規臨牀實踐中實施的證據有限。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To assess the long-term effectiveness, implementation, and sustainability of single-pill combination therapy through team-based care for blood pressure reduction among patients with uncontrolled hypertension in primary care settings in Colombia and Jamaica.
abstract.textZh: 在哥倫比亞和牙買加的初級護理環境中，透過團隊式護理，評估單一藥丸聯合治療在無法控制的高血壓患者中的長期有效性、實施和可持續性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Multicountry, unblinded, pragmatic, cluster randomized clinical trial. Twenty primary care clinics in Jamaica and 20 in Colombia were randomly assigned to either the single-pill combination therapy group or the standard care group. A total of 1706 adults with uncontrolled hypertension were enrolled between February 23, 2023, and September 12, 2024. The final follow-up visit occurred on September 9, 2026.
abstract.textZh: 多國、非盲、務實、叢集隨機臨牀試驗。牙買加的20家初級保健診所和哥倫比亞的20家初級保健診所被隨機分配到單藥聯合治療組或標準護理組。在2023年2月23日至2024年9月12日期間，共招募了1706名患有失控高血壓的成年人。最後一次追蹤覆診發生在2026年9月9日。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: In the intervention group (n = 869), a team-based care approach that included physician and nurse training, health coaching, home blood pressure monitoring, and blood pressure audit and feedback was used to implement single-pill combination therapy. Single-pill combinations were purchased locally and provided to patients. In the standard care group (n = 837), patients received monotherapy or polytherapy with guideline-recommended medications covered by health insurance or government programs. The intervention lasted 18 months, with additional follow-up at 24 months.
abstract.textZh: 在幹預組（ n = 869 ）中，使用以團隊為基礎的護理方法，包括醫生和護士培訓、健康指導、家庭血壓監測以及血壓稽核和反饋，以實施單藥丸聯合治療。單一藥丸組合在當地購買並提供給患者。在標準護理組（ n = 837 ）中，患者接受單一療法或多種療法，以及健康保險或政府計劃承保的指南推薦藥物。幹預持續了18個月，並在24個月時進行了額外的追蹤。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was the between-group difference in change in systolic blood pressure from baseline to 18 months. Three blood pressure measurements were obtained at each of 2 visits at each time point using a standard protocol.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是收縮壓從基線到18個月變化的組間差異。使用標準方案，在每個時間點的2次回診中，每次進行3次血壓測量。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among the 1706 enrolled participants, at baseline, the mean age was 61.4 years, 69.9% of participants were female, and 98.2% were taking antihypertensive medications. Among the 1574 participants included in the primary analysis, systolic blood pressure decreased by 19.1 mm Hg, from 145.9 mm Hg at baseline to 126.8 mm Hg at 18 months, in the intervention group and by 9.0 mm Hg, from 145.0 mm Hg to 136.1 mm Hg, in the standard care group, with a between-group difference of -10.1 mm Hg (95% CI, -13.3 to -6.9 mm Hg; P < .001). At 18 months, 69.5% of patients in the intervention group and 29.2% in the standard care group achieved systolic blood pressure less than 130 and diastolic blood pressure less than 80 mm Hg. Serious adverse events (death and hospitalization) occurred at similar frequencies in the intervention (7.9%) and standard care (9.9%) groups.
abstract.textZh: 在1706名入組參與者中，基線時的平均年齡為61.4歲， 69.9%的參與者為女性， 98.2%的參與者正在服用抗高血壓藥物。在主要療效分析的1574名參與者中，介入組的收縮壓降低了19.1 mm Hg ，從基線時的145.9 mm Hg降至18個月的126.8 mm Hg ，標準護理組的收縮壓降低了9.0 mm Hg ，從145.0 mm Hg降至136.1 mm Hg ，組間差異為-10.1 mm Hg (95% CI ， -13.3至-6.9 mm Hg ； P < 0.001)。在18個月時，介入組中69.5%的患者和標準護理組中29.2%的患者收縮壓小於130和舒張壓小於80 mm Hg。嚴重不良事件（死亡和住院）在幹預（ 7.9% ）和標準護理（ 9.9% ）組中發生頻率相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Implementing single-pill combination therapy through team-based care significantly reduced blood pressure over 18 months among adults with uncontrolled hypertension in Colombia and Jamaica. This comprehensive strategy integrating single-pill combination therapy with team-based care could be widely adopted and scaled up for hypertension control, particularly in resource-constrained settings.
abstract.textZh: 在哥倫比亞和牙買加，通過團隊照護實施單藥併用療法，在18個月內顯著降低了患有不受控制的高血壓的成年人的血壓。這種將單一藥丸聯合治療與團隊照護相結合的綜合策略可以被廣泛採用並擴大用於高血壓控制，特別是在資源有限的環境中。

articles.title: Low-Voltage Area Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: The COAST-AF Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Nery PB, Wells GA, Nair GM, Essebag V, Joza J, Wong JA, Veenhuyzen GD, Verma A, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) for persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) has demonstrated modest success rates. Ablation of atrial low-voltage areas (LVA) has shown potential results, but more data are required.
abstract.textZh: 持續性心房顫動（ AF ）的肺靜脈隔離（ PVI ）已顯示出適度的成功率。心房低電壓區域（ LVA ）的消融已經顯示出潛在的結果，但需要更多的數據。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether PVI plus LVA ablation is superior to PVI alone in reducing atrial arrhythmia recurrence in patients with AF.
abstract.textZh: 確定PVI加LVA消融在減少房顫患者的房性心律失常復發方面是否優於PVI單獨消融。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Single-blind randomized clinical trial in 14 AF ablation centers in Canada. Adults with persistent AF of more than 3 months were enrolled between August 2018 and September 2024 and followed up for 18 to 36 months through April 2026.
abstract.textZh: 在加拿大14個房顫消融中心進行的單盲隨機臨牀試驗。在2018年8月至2024年9月期間招募了持續性房顫超過3個月的成人，並隨訪了18至36個月，直至2026年4月。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Patients were randomized to PVI plus LVA ablation or PVI alone.
abstract.textZh: 患者被隨機分組為PVI + LVA消融或PVI單獨。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was atrial arrhythmia recurrence beyond 90 days after a single catheter ablation procedure. Secondary outcomes included repeat ablation for AF, atrial flutter, or atrial tachycardia, emergency visits or hospitalization, arrhythmia recurrence over 18 months, procedure duration, total ablation delivery time, AF burden, and safety outcomes. The primary efficacy analysis was based on the modified intention-to-treat principle for patients who received the intervention.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是單次導管消融術後90天以上的房性心律失常復發。次要結果包括重複消融房顫、房撲或房性心動過速、緊急就診或住院、18個月內心律失常復發、手術持續時間、總消融分娩時間、房顫負擔和安全結果。主要療效分析是基於對接受幹預治療的患者修改的意向治療原則。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 508 enrolled patients, 253 were randomized to PVI plus LVA ablation and 255 to PVI alone. Mean (SD) age was 65.2 (9.0) years, 386 (76%) were male and 268 (54%) had LVA. After a mean (SD) follow-up of 21 (15) months, 124 (49.4%) randomized to PVI plus LVA and 146 (57.5%) randomized to PVI reached the primary outcome (hazard ratio [HR], 0.82; 95% CI, 0.65-1.04; P = .11). In the prespecified principal subgroup analysis of 268 patients with LVA, arrhythmia recurrence occurred in 68 of 138 patients (49.3%) following PVI plus LVA ablation compared with 90 of 130 patients (69.2%) following PVI alone (HR, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.66-0.91; P = .002). Arrhythmia recurrence over 18 months (37.0% vs 56.2%; HR, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.64-0.92) and AF burden were lower after PVI plus LVA ablation in this group. Among patients without LVA, recurrence was similar between ablation groups (56 of 113 [49.6%] vs 51 of 113 [45.1%]; HR, 1.09; 95% CI, 0.90-1.32). Procedure duration and ablation delivery time were longer in the PVI plus LVA ablation group. Safety outcomes were similar between groups.
abstract.textZh: 在508名入組患者中， 253名被隨機分配至PVI加LVA消融， 255名單獨分配至PVI。 平均（ SD ）年齡為65.2 （ 9.0 ）歲， 386 （ 76 ％ ）為男性， 268 （ 54 ％ ）為LVA。 平均(SD)隨訪21 (15)個月後， 124 (49.4%)人被隨機分配至PVI + LVA ， 146 (57.5%)人被隨機分配至PVI達到主要結果(風險比[HR] ， 0.82 ； 95% CI ， 0.65-1.04 ； P = 0.11)。 在268名LVA患者的預定主要次組分析中， PVI加LVA消融後， 138名患者中有68名(49.3%)發生心律失常復發，而單獨PVI後， 130名患者中有90名(69.2%)發生心律失常復發(HR ， 0.77 ； 95% CI ， 0.66-0.91 ； P = 0.002)。 18個月內心律失常復發（ 37.0%對56.2% ； HR ， 0.77 ； 95% CI ， 0.64-0.92 ）和房顫負擔在這一組中PVI加LVA消融後較低。 在沒有LVA的患者中，消融組之間的復發相似（ 56/113 [49.6%]對51/113 [45.1%] ； HR ， 1.09 ； 95% CI ， 0.90-1.32 ）。 PVI加LVA消融組的手術持續時間和消融輸送時間較長。 各組之間的安全結果相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: In this study, among patients with persistent AF, adjunctive LVA ablation did not significantly reduce atrial arrhythmia recurrence in the overall population over a mean 21-month follow-up. A prespecified principal subgroup analysis of patients with LVA suggested that adjunctive LVA ablation was consistent with reduced recurrence of atrial arrhythmias in this group.
abstract.textZh: 在這項研究中，在持續性房顫的患者中，在平均21個月的隨訪期間，輔助LVA消融並未顯著減少整體人羣中房性心律失常的復發。對LVA患者的預先指定的主要亞組分析表明，輔助LVA消融與該組中房性心律失常復發的減少是一致的。

articles.title: Cangrelor versus crushed ticagrelor in acute myocardial infarction complicated by cardiogenic shock (DAPT-SHOCK-AMI): a randomised, double-blind trial
articles.authors: Motovska Z, Hlinomaz O, Mrozek J, Akin I, Kala P, Montalescot G, Hromadka M, Geisler T, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Acute myocardial infarction complicated by cardiogenic shock (AMI-CS) can compromise the administration and absorption of oral P2Y12 inhibitors and carries high ischaemic and mortality risks. This trial assessed whether intravenous cangrelor was non-inferior to crushed oral ticagrelor for short-term clinical outcomes and whether it provided faster and more consistent platelet inhibition in patients with AMI-CS.
abstract.textZh: 急性心肌梗死並發心源性休克（ AMI-CS ）會損害口服P2Y12抑制劑的給藥和吸收，並帶有高缺血和死亡風險。該試驗評估靜脈注射坎格雷洛爾對於短期臨牀結果是否不劣於壓碎的口服替格雷洛爾，以及它是否在AMI-CS患者中提供更快和更一致的血小板抑制。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: DAPT-SHOCK-AMI was a double-blind trial conducted at 29 hospitals across five European countries (Czech Republic, France, Germany, Poland, and Slovakia). Patients older than 18 years with AMI-CS were randomly assigned (1:1 ratio, stratified by centre, age, sex, presence or absence of ST-segment elevation, and mechanical ventilation) to cangrelor (30 μg/kg bolus followed by an infusion of 4 μg/kg per min for at least 2 h) or crushed ticagrelor (180 mg loading dose). The primary laboratory endpoint was a platelet reactivity index of less than 50% at the end of primary percutaneous coronary intervention. The primary clinical endpoint was death, myocardial infarction, or ischaemic stroke at 30 days. The primary clinical endpoint was analysed for non-inferiority with a prespecified margin of 1 percentage point among all randomly assigned patients who received study treatment. The study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03551964) and EudraCT (2018-002161-19); recruitment and 1-year follow-up are complete, and 5-year follow-up is ongoing.
abstract.textZh: DAPT-SHOCK-AMI是一項在五個歐洲國家（捷克共和國、法國、德國、波蘭和斯洛伐克）的29家醫院進行的雙盲試驗。 將18歲以上的AMI-CS患者隨機分配（ 1: 1比率，按中心、年齡、性別、是否存在ST段擡高和機械通氣分層）至cangrelor （ 30 μg/kg推注，然後每分鐘輸注4 μg/kg ，持續至少2小時）或壓碎的替格瑞洛（ 180 mg負載劑量）。 主要實驗室終點是主要經皮冠狀動脈介入治療結束時血小板反應指數小於50%。 主要臨牀終點是30天時的死亡、心肌梗塞或缺血性卒中。 在接受研究治療的所有隨機分配的患者中，主要臨牀終點被分析為非劣效性，預先指定的邊際為1個百分點。 本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03551964)和EudraCT (2018-002161-19)註冊；招募和1年隨訪已完成， 5年隨訪仍在進行中。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Aug 1, 2018, and Jan 19, 2024, 605 patients (137 [23%] were female) were randomly assigned to cangrelor (n=298) or ticagrelor (n=307); no surviving patients were lost to the 1-year follow-up. The primary laboratory endpoint was analysed in 56 (19%) patients in the cangrelor group and 68 (22%) in the ticagrelor group, and was achieved in 56 (100%) of 56 patients receiving cangrelor and 15 (22%) of 68 receiving ticagrelor (p<0·0001). The 30-day primary clinical endpoint occurred in 112 (38%) of 298 patients receiving cangrelor and 126 (41%) of 307 receiving ticagrelor; non-inferiority was not demonstrated (difference -4 percentage points [90% CI -10 to 3]; Pnon-inferiority=0·13). Major bleeding at 30 days occurred in 19 (6%) of 298 patients receiving cangrelor and 16 (5%) of 307 receiving ticagrelor.
abstract.textZh: 在2018年8月1日至2024年1月19日期間， 605名患者（ 137名[23%]為女性）被隨機分配到cangrelor （ n = 298 ）或ticagrelor （ n = 307 ） ；在1年的隨訪中沒有存活的患者失蹤。主要實驗室終點在cangrelor組的56 (19%)名患者和替格瑞洛組的68 (22%)名患者中進行分析，在接受cangrelor的56名患者和接受替格瑞洛的68名患者中達到56 (100%)名患者和15 (22%)名患者(p < 0.0001)。30天主要臨牀終點發生在接受cangrelor的298名患者中的112名（ 38% ）和接受替格瑞洛的307名患者中的126名（ 41% ） ；未證明非劣效性（差異-4個百分點[90% CI -10至3] ；非劣效性= 0.13 ）。298名接受cangrelor的患者中有19名（ 6% ）在30天時出現嚴重出血， 307名接受替格瑞洛的患者中有16名（ 5% ）出血。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: To our knowledge, this is the first randomised trial to compare P2Y12 inhibitor strategies specifically in patients with AMI-CS. Cangrelor achieved effective platelet inhibition more frequently than crushed ticagrelor at the end of primary percutaneous coronary intervention. Non-inferiority of cangrelor versus crushed ticagrelor was not demonstrated for the primary 30-day clinical endpoint. These trial findings can inform future trials of P2Y12 inhibition strategies in patients with AMI-CS.
abstract.textZh: 據我們所知，這是第一個在AMI-CS患者中比較P2Y12抑制劑策略的隨機試驗。在主要經皮冠狀動脈介入治療結束時， Cangrelor比壓碎的替格瑞洛更頻繁地實現有效的血小板抑制。在主要的30天臨牀終點中，未證明坎格瑞洛與壓碎的替格瑞洛的非劣效性。這些試驗結果可以為AMI-CS患者中P2Y12抑制策略的未來試驗提供信息。

articles.title: Performance of 0/1 h versus 0/3 h pathways in patients with suspected myocardial infarction: a systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
articles.authors: Boeddinghaus J, Kunz M, Lopez-Ayala P, Khand A, Inoue K, Hatherley J, Miller J, Lambrakis K, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In patients with suspected myocardial infarction, the 0/1 h pathway (blood draws at 0 h and 1 h) is recommended in current guidelines for early risk stratification. However, individual trials used different safety outcomes, and efficacy outcomes were inconclusive or not assessed. We conducted a systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis of all randomised controlled trials to synthesise the totality of the evidence, assess heterogeneity across trials, and evaluate clinically relevant outcomes using harmonised definitions across trials.
abstract.textZh: 在疑似心肌梗塞的患者中，建議在目前的早期風險分層指南中採用0/1小時途徑（在0小時和1小時抽血）。然而，個別試驗使用不同的安全性結果，有效性結果不具結論或未評估。我們對所有隨機對照試驗進行了系統審查和個別參與者數據薈萃分析，以合成全部證據，評估試驗之間的異質性，並使用試驗之間的統一定義來評估臨牀相關結果。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis, we searched PubMed, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Scopus, and the International Clinical Trials Registry Platform from inception to July 6, 2026, without language restrictions, for randomised trials comparing the safety and efficacy of 0/1 h versus 0/3 h pathways (blood draws at 0 h and 3 h, ie, standard care). Individual participant data were obtained and outcome definitions were harmonised. The primary analysis used a two-stage random-effects meta-analysis. After receipt of the individual participant data but before data harmonisation or analysis, the primary safety outcome was refined to a composite of all-cause death or new type 1 myocardial infarction within 30 days, from the originally specified composite of all-cause death or any new myocardial infarction. The primary efficacy outcomes were emergency department length of stay and direct discharge from the emergency department. This meta-analysis is registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261383452).
abstract.textZh: 在這項系統回顧和個別參與者資料薈萃分析中，我們搜尋了PubMed、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、Scopus和International Clinical Trials Registry Platform ，從開始到2026年7月6日，沒有語言限制，用於隨機試驗，比較0/1小時與0/3小時途徑的安全性和有效性（在0小時和3小時抽血，即標準護理）。 取得個別參與者資料，並統一結果定義。 主要療效分析使用兩階段隨機效應薈萃分析。 在收到個別參與者數據後，但在數據統一或分析之前，主要安全性結果從最初指定的全因死亡或任何新的心肌梗塞的綜合治療改進為30天內的全因死亡或新的1型心肌梗塞的綜合治療。 主要療效結果是急診部門的住院時間和直接從急診部門出院。 此薈萃分析已在PROSPERO （ CRD420261383452 ）註冊。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Our systematic review identified five randomised trials, all of which provided individual participant data. Among these, the definition of the primary safety outcome varied, and in four trials emergency department length of stay was not reported for the whole analysis population. We included 110 933 patient presentations (55 489 managed with the 0/1 h pathway and 55 444 managed with the 0/3 h pathway). Within 30 days, all-cause death or new type 1 myocardial infarction occurred in 446 patient presentations (0·8%) with the 0/1 h pathway versus 562 patient presentations (1·0%) with the 0/3 h pathway (random-effects pooled odds ratio [OR] 0·83 [95% CI 0·45-1·53]; I2=62·9%; τ2=0·143). Emergency department length of stay was 314 min (IQR 211-481) in the 0/1 h pathway group versus 308 min (209-453) in the 0/3 h pathway group (random-effects pooled geometric mean ratio 1·03 [95% CI 0·85-1·25]; I2=99·2%; τ2=0·024). Direct discharge from the emergency department occurred in 37 190 patient presentations (67·0%) with the 0/1 h pathway versus 36 485 patient presentations (65·8%) with the 0/3 h pathway (random-effects pooled OR 1·31 [95% CI 0·79-2·16]; I2=97·8%; τ2=0·156).
abstract.textZh: 我們的系統綜述確定了五項隨機試驗，所有這些試驗都提供了個別參與者的數據。 其中，主要安全性結果的定義各不相同，在四項試驗中，沒有報告整個分析人羣的急診科住院時間。 我們納入了110 933例患者介紹（ 55 489例通過0/1小時途徑進行管理， 55 444例通過0/3小時途徑進行管理）。 在30天內，全因死亡或新的1型心肌梗塞發生在446名患者中（ 0.8 ％ ） ，使用0/1小時途徑，而562名患者（ 1.0 ％ ）使用0/3小時途徑（隨機效應匯總比率[OR] 0.83 [95 ％ CI 0.45-1.53]; I2 = 62.9 ％; τ2 = 0.143 ）。 0/1小時通路組的急診科住院時間為314分鐘(IQR 211-481) ，而0/3小時通路組的住院時間為308分鐘(209-453) (隨機效應混合幾何平均值比率1 · 03 [95% CI 0 · 85-1 · 25] ； I2 = 99 · 2% ； τ2 = 0 · 024)。 0/1小時路徑的37 190名患者(67 · 0%)直接出院，而0/3小時路徑的36 485名患者(65 · 8%)直接出院(隨機效應合併或1 · 31 [95% CI 0 · 79-2 · 16] ； I2 = 97 · 8% ； τ2 = 0 · 156)。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Across the available randomised trials, short-term adverse event rates were low with both pathways, but the pooled safety estimate remained imprecise. On average, earlier cardiac troponin retesting did not reduce emergency department length of stay or clearly increase direct discharge, and substantial between-study heterogeneity indicates that treatment effects might not translate uniformly across health-care systems. articles.title: Ruzaltatug rezetecan versus chemotherapy for EGFR-mutated advanced non-small-cell lung cancer progressing after EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy (HERON-Lung01): interim analysis of a randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial in China
articles.authors: Xu CR, Zhang Y, Lin G, Wang H, Wang Q, Huang D, Yu Y, Zhou J, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Ruzaltatug rezetecan is a novel HER3-directed antibody-drug conjugate that has shown promising antitumour activity and manageable safety in pretreated EGFR-.mutated non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in a phase 1 trial. We aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of ruzaltatug rezetecan with chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC that had progressed after EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy.
abstract.textZh: Ruzaltatug rezetecan是一種新型HER3靶向抗體-藥物偶聯物，在1期試驗中，在預先治療的EGFR突變型非小細胞肺癌（ NSCLC ）中顯示出有希望的抗腫瘤活性和可控的安全性。我們旨在比較Ruzaltatug Rezetecan與化療在EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制劑(TKI)治療後進展的EGFR突變晚期NSCLC患者中的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: HERON-Lung01 is a randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial conducted at 62 sites in China. Eligible patients were aged 18-75 years, with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC harbouring an EGFR activating mutation (exon 19 deletion or L858R mutation), and had progressed during or after EGFR-TKI therapy. Patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive ruzaltatug rezetecan 8·0 mg/kg or chemotherapy comprising pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 plus carboplatin (area under the curve 5) or cisplatin 75 mg/m2 for four cycles, followed by maintenance pemetrexed. All treatments were administered intravenously on day 1 of each 3-week cycle. Block randomisation was stratified by presence of brain metastases, EGFR mutation subtype, and use of a first-line third-generation EGFR-TKI. The primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS), as assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR), in the intention-to-treat population. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06671379). Recruitment is complete, with the trial ongoing.
abstract.textZh: HERON-Lung01是一項在中國62個研究中心進行的隨機、開放標籤、3期試驗。 符合資格的患者年齡為18-75歲，局部晚期或轉移性非鱗狀NSCLC含有EGFR活化突變（外顯子19缺失或L858R突變） ，並且在EGFR-TKI治療期間或之後進展。 患者被隨機分配(1: 1)接受ruzaltatug rezetecan 8 · 0 mg/kg或化療，包括培美曲塞500 mg/m2加卡鉑(曲線下面積5)或順鉑75 mg/m2 ，共4個週期，然後維持培美曲塞。 所有治療均在每個3週週期的第1天靜脈內給藥。 通過存在腦轉移、EGFR突變亞型和第一線第三代EGFR-TKI的使用進行區塊隨機分層。 主要終點是意向治療族羣中的無惡化存活期（ PFS ） ，由盲獨立中央審查（ BICR ）評估。 本試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT06671379 ）註冊。 招募工作已經完成，試驗正在進行中。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Nov 29, 2024, and Jan 29, 2026, 498 patients were randomly assigned to receive ruzaltatug rezetecan (n=250) or chemotherapy (n=248). The median age was 60·0 years (IQR 54·0-68·0); 276 (55%) patients were female and 222 (45%) male. At the prespecified interim PFS analysis, median follow-up was 7·7 months (95% CI 7·1-8·3). BICR-assessed PFS was significantly longer with ruzaltatug rezetecan than with chemotherapy (median 8·3 months vs 5·4 months; hazard ratio 0·47 [95% CI 0·36-0·60]; one-sided p<0·0001). Grade 3 or worse treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs) occurred in 101 (41%) of 248 patients receiving ruzaltatug rezetecan and 93 (39%) of 239 patients receiving chemotherapy, most commonly decreased neutrophil count (64 [26%] of 248 patients vs 46 [19%] of 239 patients), decreased white blood cell count (29 [12%] vs 29 [12%]), and anaemia (15 [6%] vs 26 [11%]). TRAEs led to treatment discontinuation in three (1%) patients in the ruzaltatug rezetecan group and three (1%) in the chemotherapy group. One death (unknown cause) in the ruzaltatug rezetecan group was considered by the investigator to be possibly treatment related.
abstract.textZh: 在2024年11月29日至2026年1月29日期間， 498名患者被隨機分配接受ruzaltatug rezetecan （ n = 250 ）或化療（ n = 248 ）。 中位年齡為60 · 0歲(IQR 54 · 0-68 · 0) ； 276 (55%)名患者為女性， 222 (45%)名患者為男性。 在預先指定的中期PFS分析中，中位隨訪時間為7 · 7個月(95% CI 7 · 1-8 · 3)。 使用Ruzaltatug Rezetecan評估的BICR PFS顯著長於化療（中位數8.3個月對比5.4個月；風險比0.47 [95% CI 0.36-0.60] ；單側p < 0.0001 ）。 接受ruzaltatug rezetecan的248名患者中有101名（ 41 ％ ）和接受化療的239名患者中有93名（ 39 ％ ）發生3級或更差的治療相關不良事件（ TRAE ） ，最常見的是中性白血球計數降低（ 248名患者中有64名[26 ％] vs 239名患者中有46名[19 ％] ）、白細胞計數降低（ 29名[12 ％] vs 29名[12 ％] ）和貧血（ 15名[6 ％] vs 26名[11 ％] ）。 TRAE導致ruzaltatug rezetecan組中有三名（ 1% ）患者停止治療，化療組中有三名（ 1% ）患者停止治療。 研究者認為ruzaltatug rezetecan組中有1例死亡（原因不明）可能與治療相關。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Ruzaltatug rezetecan significantly prolonged PFS compared with chemotherapy, with a manageable safety profile, in EGFR-TKI-resistant, EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC. These data support ruzaltatug rezetecan as a potential treatment option in this setting.
abstract.textZh: 在EGFR-TKI抗性、EGFR突變的晚期NSCLC中，與化療相比， Ruzaltatug rezetecan顯著延長了PFS ，具有可控的安全性。這些數據支持ruzaltatug rezetecan作為此設置中的潛在治療選項。

articles.title: Safety and efficacy of the 0/1 h pathway for myocardial infarction in the emergency department: an international, pragmatic, stepped-wedge, cluster-randomised, controlled trial
articles.authors: Boeddinghaus J, Bima P, Crisanti L, Keller DI, Slankamenac K, Christ M, Schuetz P, Wiencierz A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The evaluation of patients with suspected myocardial infarction relies on serial measurements of high-sensitivity cardiac troponin. We aimed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of implementing the guideline-recommended 0/1 h pathway, compared with a 0/3 h pathway, in hospitals that had not yet adopted the newer strategy.
abstract.textZh: 對疑似心肌梗塞患者的評估依賴於高敏感性心肌肌鈣蛋白的連續測量。我們旨在評估在尚未採用較新策略的醫院中實施指南建議的0/1小時途徑與0/3小時途徑的安全性和有效性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: PRESC1SE-MI was an international, pragmatic, stepped-wedge, cluster-randomised, controlled, masked-endpoint trial at 19 hospitals in ten countries. The study included consecutive adults presenting to the emergency department with acute non-traumatic chest discomfort and suspected myocardial infarction. Hospitals using a 0/3 h pathway (blood draws at 0 h and 3 h) as standard care were randomly allocated to implement the 0/1 h pathway (blood draws at 0 h and 1 h) after 6 months (early implementation) or 12 months (late implementation). The trial was designed to test the non-inferiority of the 0/1 h pathway for safety and its superiority for efficacy. The non-inferiority margin was set at an odds ratio of 1·3. Analyses were done in the full analysis set. The coprimary safety outcome was a composite of death from any cause or new type 1 myocardial infarction within 30 days, and the coprimary efficacy outcome was emergency department length of stay. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05649384, and is active but no longer enrolling.
abstract.textZh: PRESC1SE-MI是一項國際性、務實、階梯式楔形、叢集隨機、對照、遮罩端點試驗，在10個國家的19家醫院進行。 該研究包括連續的成年人，他們在急診室出現急性非創傷性胸部不適和疑似心肌梗塞。 在6個月（早期實施）或12個月（晚期實施）後，使用0/3小時途徑（在0小時和3小時抽血）作為標準護理的醫院被隨機分配以實施0/1小時途徑（在0小時和1小時抽血）。 該試驗旨在測試0/1小時通路的安全性和有效性的非劣效性。 非劣效性邊際設定為比值比1 · 3。 在完整的分析集中完成分析。 共原發安全性結果是30天內任何原因或新發1型心肌梗死死亡的綜合結果，而共原發有效性結果是急診科住院時間。 此試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov註冊，編號為NCT05649384 ，目前正在進行，但不再招募。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Dec 1, 2020, and Dec 31, 2024, 71 983 consecutive patient presentations were screened, of which 67 624 (93·9%) met the eligibility criteria and comprised the full analysis set. Median age was 59 years (IQR 46-73); 29 954 (44·3%) patient presentations were in female patients and 37 670 (55·7%) were in male patients. 13 753 (22·2%) of 62 060 patient presentations with available data were in patients with known coronary artery disease, and 5855 (8·7%) patient presentations had an adjudicated index diagnosis of myocardial infarction. Overall, 36 464 patient presentations were managed with a 0/3 h pathway and 31 160 with the 0/1 h pathway. Death from any cause or new type 1 myocardial infarction occurred in 454 (1·2%) patient presentations in the 0/3 h group and in 341 (1·1%) patient presentations in the 0/1 h group (adjusted odds ratio 0·93 [95% CI 0·77-1·13]; pnon-inferiority=0·0004). The median emergency department length of stay was 309 min (IQR 203-470) in the 0/3 h pathway and 309 min (207-474) in the 0/1 h pathway (ratio of adjusted median times 1·00 [95% CI 0·97-1·02]; two-sided p=0·65).
abstract.textZh: 在2020年12月1日至2024年12月31日期間，篩選了71 983例連續的患者呈現，其中67 624 （ 93.9 ％ ）符合資格標準，並包含完整的分析集。 中位年齡為59歲（ IQR 46-73 ） ； 29,954 （ 44.3 ％ ）名患者呈現女性患者和37,670 （ 55.7 ％ ）名男性患者。在有可用數據的62,060名患者呈現中， 13,753 （ 22.2 ％ ）名患者呈現已知冠狀動脈疾病的患者， 5,855 （ 8.7 ％ ）名患者呈現心肌梗塞的判定指標診斷。 總體而言， 36,464名患者以0/3小時的途徑進行治療， 31,160名患者以0/1小時的途徑進行治療。 0/3小時組的454 (1 · 2%)名患者和0/1小時組的341 (1 · 1%)名患者因任何原因或新發1型心肌梗死而死亡(調整比值比0 · 93 [95% CI 0 · 77-1 · 13] ；非劣效性= 0 · 0004)。 0/3小時路徑的急診科住院時間中位數為309分鐘(IQR 203-470) ， 0/1小時路徑的住院時間中位數為309分鐘(207-474) (調整後的中位數時間比值1 · 00 [95% CI 0 · 97-1 · 02] ；雙側p = 0 · 65)。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Implementation of the 0/1 h pathway met the prespecified non-inferiority criterion for the 30-day composite safety outcome but did not shorten emergency department length of stay compared with the 0/3 h pathway. In this setting, implementation of the 0/1 h pathway alone should therefore not be expected to improve emergency department throughput.

articles.title: Generalised eruptive histiocytosis mimicking lymphoma relapse in a patient with previous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
articles.authors: Martins F, Caetano D, Calvão J, Cardoso JC

abstract.text: A 92-year-old man with a history of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma treated with chemoradiotherapy, and later with radiotherapy for an isolated cutaneous relapse with complete response, presented with a 1-month history of multiple asymptomatic erythematous-to-violaceous papules and nodules on the face, trunk, and upper limbs. Given his oncological history and previous skin involvement, lymphoma relapse was the leading diagnostic concern, with cutaneous metastases and sarcoidosis also considered. However, skin biopsies showed a non-Langerhans cell histiocytic infiltrate expressing CD45, CD68, and CD163, without CD1a, CD20, PAX5, S100, or Langerin expression. Skin and blood flow cytometry identified no abnormal cell populations, and a PET-CT scan showed no abnormal metabolic activity. Clinicopathological correlation narrowed the differential to group C (cutaneous) histiocytosis, and subsequent spontaneous regression of the lesions over 3 months without treatment supported the diagnosis of generalised eruptive histiocytosis. At 15 months of follow-up, there was no recurrence or evidence of active disease. This case illustrates that cutaneous histiocytoses can mimic several inflammatory and neoplastic conditions, including lymphoma relapse, reinforcing the need to actively resist cognitive bias in people who have had cancer through reflective reassessment, broad differential diagnosis, and biopsy confirmation.
abstract.textZh: 一名92歲的男子，有彌漫性大B細胞淋巴瘤病史，接受放化療，後來接受放射治療，治療單獨的皮膚復發，完全緩解，在面部、軀幹和上肢出現多個無症狀紅斑到病毒性丘疹和結節的1個月病史。 鑑於他的腫瘤史和既往皮膚受累，淋巴瘤復發是主要的診斷問題，同時也考慮了皮膚轉移和結節病。 然而，皮膚活組織檢查顯示非郎格罕氏細胞組織細胞浸潤表達CD45、CD68和CD163 ，沒有CD1a、CD20、PAX5、S100或Langerin表達。 皮膚和血液流式細胞檢查未發現異常細胞羣， PET-CT掃描未發現異常代謝活動。 臨牀病理學相關性縮小了與C組（皮膚）組織細胞增多症的差異，並且隨後在未接受治療的3個月內病竈的自發性消退支持了廣泛性爆發性組織細胞增多症的診斷。 在追蹤15個月時，沒有復發或活動性疾病的證據。 該案例說明，皮膚組織細胞增多症可以模擬幾種炎症和腫瘤狀況，包括淋巴瘤復發，強化了通過反射性重新評估、廣泛的鑑別診斷和活組織檢查確認來積極抵抗癌症患者認知偏見的必要性。

abstract.textZh: 缺血將患者隨機分為初始侵入性策略（指引導向的藥物治療加上冠狀動脈造影和血管重建（在可行的情況下） ）或初始保守性策略（僅使用指引導向的藥物治療） ，並對藥物治療失敗進行侵入性管理。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: All-cause, cardiovascular, and noncardiovascular mortality were analyzed using cumulative incidence estimates, Cox and Fine-Gray models, bayesian analysis, and restricted mean survival time.
abstract.textZh: 使用累計發生率估計、Cox和Fine-Gray模型、貝葉斯分析和受限平均存活時間分析全因、心血管和非心血管死亡率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 5179 participants, median age was 64 (IQR, 58-70) years; 23% were female, 42% had diabetes, and median ejection fraction was 60% (IQR, 55%-65%). During 9-year median follow-up (range, 1 day to 13.4 years), 1071 deaths occurred (782 during extended follow-up): 672 cardiovascular, 359 noncardiovascular, and 40 unclassified. All-cause 11-year mortality was not significantly different between groups (25.8% invasive vs 26.9% conservative; estimated difference, -1.0 percentage point [95% CI, -4.2 to 2.1 percentage points]; adjusted hazard ratio [AHR], 0.97 [95% CI, 0.86-1.09]). By bayesian analysis, the posterior probability of more than 1 percentage-point survival benefit to invasive vs conservative was low (18%). Cardiovascular mortality at 11 years was 15.8% in the invasive group vs 17.1% in the conservative group (estimated difference, -1.4 percentage points [95% CI, -4.0 to 1.3 percentage points]; AHR, 0.88 [95% CI, 0.75-1.02]). Noncardiovascular mortality at 11 years was 9.1% in the invasive group vs 8.1% in the conservative group (estimated difference, 1.0 percentage point [95% CI, -0.9 to 2.9 percentage points]; AHR, 1.18 [95% CI, 0.96-1.45]). Eleven-year restricted mean survival was not significantly different (estimated difference, 14 days [95% CI, -41 to 70 days]).
abstract.textZh: 在5179名參與者中，中位年齡為64 (IQR ， 58-70)歲； 23%為女性， 42%為糖尿病患者，中位射血分數為60% (IQR ， 55% -65%)。 在9年的中位隨訪期間（範圍為1天至13.4年） ，發生了1071例死亡（延長隨訪期間為782例） ： 672例心血管死亡、359例非心血管死亡和40例未分類死亡。 各組之間的全因11年死亡率並無顯著差異（ 25.8%侵入性與26.9%保守性；估計差異為-1.0個百分點[95% CI ， -4.2至2.1個百分點] ；調整風險比[AHR] ， 0.97 [95% CI ， 0.86-1.09] ）。 通過貝葉斯分析，侵襲性與保守性之間超過1個百分點生存期受益的後天概率較低（ 18 ％ ）。 入侵組11年時的心血管死亡率為15.8% ，而保守組為17.1% （估計差異為-1.4個百分點[95% CI ， -4.0至1.3個百分點] ； AHR ， 0.88 [95% CI ， 0.75-1.02] ）。 11年的非心血管死亡率在侵入性組中為9.1% ，而在保守性組中為8.1% （估計差異， 1.0個百分點[95% CI ， -0.9至2.9個百分點] ； AHR ， 1.18 [95% CI ， 0.96-1.45] ）。 11年限制性平均存活率沒有顯著差異（估計差異， 14天[95% CI ， -41至70天] ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: In this study, long-term all-cause mortality in patients with high-risk chronic coronary disease was not significantly different after routine invasive vs initial conservative management.
abstract.textZh: 在這項研究中，高風險慢性冠狀動脈疾病患者的長期全因死亡率在常規侵入性與初始保守性管理之間沒有顯著差異。

articles.title: Intravenous Thrombolysis for Acute Ischemic Stroke - New Directions
articles.authors: Grotta JC

abstract.text: In the past 5 years, substantial changes have been made in the use of intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) in patients with acute ischemic stroke. Integrating IVT with endovascular thrombectomy, which improves outcomes in patients with stroke due to large cerebral vessel occlusion, has been a particular challenge. This review discusses the underlying vascular targets for IVT and thrombectomy, the increasing use of tenecteplase instead of alteplase, broadening indications for the use of IVT, and ancillary drugs and dosing methods that may augment the success of IVT.
abstract.textZh: 在過去5年中，急性缺血性卒中患者靜脈溶栓（ IVT ）的使用發生了重大變化。將IVT與血管內血栓切除整合，改善因大腦血管阻塞而中風患者的預後，一直是一個特別的挑戰。本綜述討論IVT和血栓切除的潛在血管目標、增加使用替奈普酶而不是阿替普酶、擴大IVT使用適應症，以及可能增加IVT成功的輔助藥物和劑量方法。

articles.title: Plozasiran for Severe Hypertriglyceridemia and Risk of Pancreatitis
articles.authors: Watts GF, Ballantyne CM, Blanco Echevarria A, Smith J, Rosenson RS, Subramanian S, Trippi J, Lepor N, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Severe hypertriglyceridemia is associated with an increased risk of acute pancreatitis. Plozasiran, a small interfering RNA targeting APOC3 messenger RNA, lowers triglyceride levels and potentially mitigates the risk of acute pancreatitis.
abstract.textZh: 嚴重高甘油三酯血症與急性胰腺炎風險增加有關。Plozasiran是一種針對APOC3信使RNA的小型幹擾RNA ，可降低甘油三酯水平，並可能降低急性胰腺炎的風險。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In two double-blind, placebo-controlled trials, 757 adults with severe hypertriglyceridemia were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive plozasiran (25 mg) or placebo at baseline and at months 3, 6, and 9. These trials had identical designs, end points, and analytic plans. The primary end point was the percent change in the fasting plasma triglyceride level from baseline to month 12. Key secondary end points were the percent change in the fasting triglyceride level from baseline to month 10, a fasting triglyceride level of less than 500 mg per deciliter (5.6 mmol per liter) and less than 150 mg per deciliter (1.7 mmol per liter), the percent change in the fasting serum triglyceride level at month 12 for patients with a baseline triglyceride level of 880 mg per deciliter or greater, and changes in remnant cholesterol and non-HDL cholesterol. A pooled analysis addressed adjudicated acute pancreatitis, incidence, and first-event timing.
abstract.textZh: 在兩項雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗中， 757名患有嚴重高甘油三酯血症的成年人以2: 1的比例被隨機分配在基線期和第3、6和9個月接受plozasiran (25 mg)或安慰劑。這些試驗具有相同的設計、終點和分析計劃。主要終點是空腹血漿甘油三酯水平從基線到第12個月的變化百分比。次要關鍵終點是空腹甘油三酯濃度從基線到第10個月的變化百分比，空腹甘油三酯濃度低於500毫克/分升（ 5.6毫摩爾/升）和低於150毫克/分升（ 1.7毫摩爾/升） ，基線甘油三酯濃度為880毫克/分升或更高的患者在第12個月的空腹血清甘油三酯濃度變化百分比，以及殘留膽固醇和非HDL膽固醇的變化。一項匯總分析解決了判定的急性胰腺炎、發病率和首次事件發生時間。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: At month 12, patients in the plozasiran groups had a median triglyceride level that was lower than the baseline level by 79% and 81% in the two trials. These reductions corresponded to a median difference in the plozasiran groups as compared with the placebo groups (placebo-adjusted change) of -45 percentage points (95% confidence interval [CI], -51 to -38) and -47 percentage points (95% CI, -54 to -39). A triglyceride level of less than 500 mg per deciliter at 12 months was reported in 91% and 93% of the patients in the plozasiran groups and in 51% and 50% of those in the placebo groups (P<0.001). The rates of acute pancreatitis were 1 per 100 patient-years with plozasiran and 5 per 100 patient-years with placebo (rate ratio, 0.22; P = 0.008). Adverse events during treatment occurred in 73% of the patients in both the pooled plozasiran and placebo groups.
abstract.textZh: 在第12個月， plozasiran組的患者在兩項試驗中的甘油三酯中位數水平比基線水平低79%和81%。這些減少對應於plozasiran組與安慰劑組之間的中位數差異（安慰劑調整變化） -45個百分點（ 95 ％置信區間[CI] ， -51至-38 ）和-47個百分點（ 95 ％ CI ， -54至-39 ）。plozasiran組中91%和93%的患者以及安慰劑組中51%和50%的患者報告在12個月時甘油三酯水平低於500毫克/分升（ P < 0.001 ）。使用plozasiran的急性胰腺炎發生率為每100患者年1例，使用安慰劑的急性胰腺炎發生率為每100患者年5例（發生率比為0.22 ； P = 0.008 ）。治療期間的不良事件發生在合併plozasiran和安慰劑組中73%的患者中。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with severe hypertriglyceridemia, the use of plozasiran resulted in lower triglyceride levels and a lower risk of acute pancreatitis than placebo at 12 months. (Funded by Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals; SHASTA-3 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06347003; SHASTA-4, NCT06347016.).
abstract.textZh: 在患有嚴重高甘油三酯血症的患者中，使用plozasiran導致甘油三酯水平降低，並且在12個月時比安慰劑降低急性胰腺炎的風險。（由Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals資助； SHASTA-3 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06347003 ； SHASTA-4 ， NCT06347016。）。

articles.title: Interim Analysis of a Phase 3 Trial of Povetacicept in IgA Nephropathy
articles.authors: Barratt J, Zhang H, Han SH, Suzuki Y, Tumlin J, Chacko B, Noronha IL, Madan A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and a proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL) have distinct roles in IgA-producing B-cell populations and appear to be central to the pathogenesis of IgA nephropathy. Povetacicept, an enhanced, variant transmembrane activator and calcium-modulator and cyclophilin-ligand interactor (TACI)-Fc fragment fusion therapeutic, is engineered for dual inhibition of BAFF and APRIL.
abstract.textZh: B細胞活化因子（ BAFF ）和增殖誘導配體（ APRIL ）在產生IgA的B細胞羣中具有不同的作用，並且似乎是IgA腎病發病機制的核心。Povetacicept是一種增強型跨膜活化劑和鈣調節劑以及親環素配體相互作用物（ TACI ） -Fc片段融合治療劑，專為雙重抑制BAFF和APRIL而設計。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this ongoing, phase 3, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, participants with biopsy-proven IgA nephropathy receiving stable background therapy were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive povetacicept at a dose of 80 mg or placebo subcutaneously every 4 weeks. The primary end point of this prespecified interim analysis was the change in the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at week 36. Secondary end points were the change at week 36 in galactose-deficient IgA1 levels and hematuria resolution at week 36 among participants with baseline hematuria.
abstract.textZh: 在這項正在進行的3期、雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗中，接受穩定背景治療的經活組織檢查證實的IgA腎病參與者以2: 1的比例被隨機分配接受80毫克劑量的povetacicept或每4週一次的安慰劑皮下治療。這項預先規定的期中分析的主要終點是第36週24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率的變化。次要終點是基線期血尿參與者中第36週半乳糖缺乏IgA1水平的變化和第36週血尿消退。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 557 participants received povetacicept (372 participants) or placebo (185 participants). Efficacy analyses included the first 199 participants who had undergone randomization (131 in the povetacicept group and 68 in the placebo group). The 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio decreased by 52.0% with povetacicept and by 4.3% with placebo by week 36 (adjusted difference, -49.8 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -58.6 to -39.2; P<0.001). Galactose-deficient IgA1 levels decreased by 77.4% with povetacicept and increased by 9.1% with placebo (adjusted difference, -79.3 percentage points; 95% CI, -82.2 to -75.9; P<0.001). Among the participants with baseline hematuria, resolution occurred in 85% with povetacicept and in 23% with placebo (adjusted difference, 62 percentage points; 95% CI, 45 to 78; P<0.001). The incidence of adverse events (75% with povetacicept and 78% with placebo) and serious adverse events (3% and 4%, respectively) were similar in the trial groups.
abstract.textZh: 共有557名參與者接受povetacicept （ 372名參與者）或安慰劑（ 185名參與者）。 療效分析包括首199名經過隨機分組的參與者（ povetacicept組131名和安慰劑組68名）。 到第36週， 24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率在povetacicept組下降了52.0% ，在安慰劑組下降了4.3% （調整後的差異， -49.8個百分點； 95%置信區間[CI] ， -58.6至-39.2 ； P < 0.001 ）。 半乳糖缺乏的IgA1水平在povetacicept中下降了77.4% ，在安慰劑中增加了9.1% （調整後的差異， -79.3個百分點； 95% CI ， -82.2至-75.9 ； P < 0.001 ）。 在基線期血尿的參與者中， povetacicept的解決率為85% ，安慰劑的解決率為23% （調整差異， 62個百分點； 95% CI ， 45至78 ； P < 0.001 ）。 試驗組中不良事件的發生率（ povetacicept為75% ，安慰劑為78% ）和嚴重不良事件的發生率（分別為3%和4% ）相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Povetacicept led to a significantly greater reduction in the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio than placebo by week 36 in participants with IgA nephropathy. (Funded by Vertex Pharmaceuticals; RAINIER AIS-D08 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06564142.).
abstract.textZh: 在IgA腎病參與者中， Povetacicept導致24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率在第36週顯著大於安慰劑。（由Vertex Pharmaceuticals資助； RAINIER AIS-D08 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06564142。）。

articles.title: Retatrutide, a Triple Hormone Receptor Agonist, for Treatment of Obesity
articles.authors: Jastreboff AM, Kaplan LM, Davies MJ, Wilding JPH, Ahmad NN, Murray M, Du Y, Makarova N, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Retatrutide is a triple-receptor agonist of glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide, glucagon-like peptide-1, and glucagon receptors.
abstract.textZh: Retatrutide是葡萄糖依賴性促胰島素多肽、胰高血糖素樣肽-1和胰高血糖素受體的三重受體激動劑。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3, randomized, double-blind trial, we assigned adults with obesity without diabetes to receive a once-weekly subcutaneous injection of retatrutide (at a dose of 4 mg, 9 mg, or 12 mg) or placebo for 80 weeks. Primary outcomes (evaluated in the 9-mg and 12-mg groups each vs. placebo) were the percent change in body weight and the change in the WOMAC pain score (ranging from 1 to 10, with higher scores indicating worse pain) in the subgroup of 574 participants with knee osteoarthritis and the change in the apnea-hypopnea index in the 243 participants with obstructive sleep apnea. For weight-related end points, intercurrent events were handled by a treatment-regimen estimand (intention-to-treat [ITT]). For end points in participants with knee osteoarthritis or obstructive sleep apnea, a hybrid-treatment estimand was applied, with a hypothetical strategy for intercurrent events suggesting treatment failure; ITT results are also reported.
abstract.textZh: 在這項3期隨機雙盲試驗中，我們指派沒有糖尿病的肥胖成人接受每週一次的retatrutide皮下注射（劑量為4mg、9mg或12mg ）或安慰劑，為期80週。主要結果（在9毫克和12毫克組與安慰劑組中評估）是574名膝關節骨性關節炎參與者的體重變化百分比和WOMAC疼痛評分變化（範圍從1到10 ，評分越高表示疼痛越嚴重） ，以及243名阻塞性睡眠呼吸暫停參與者的呼吸暫停低通氣指數變化。對於與體重相關的終點，同時發生的事件由治療方案評估和（意向性治療[ITT] ）處理。對於患有膝關節骨性關節炎或阻塞性睡眠呼吸暫停的參與者的終點，應用混合治療估計，並針對提示治療失敗的並發事件採取假設策略；還報告了ITT結果。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 2339 participants underwent randomization. The mean percent change in body weight in the retatrutide groups was -17.6% (4-mg dose), -23.7% (9-mg dose), and -25.0% (12-mg dose) versus -3.9% in the placebo group (differences, -19.8 and -21.0 percentage points, respectively; P<0.001 for both comparisons). Among the participants with knee osteoarthritis, the corresponding changes in the pain score in the retatrutide groups for the hybrid estimand were -3.2, -3.5, and -3.6 versus -1.9 with placebo (differences, -1.6 and -1.8 points; both P<0.001); the corresponding changes for the ITT estimand were -3.4, -3.9, and -4.1 versus -2.5 with placebo (differences, -1.4 and -1.6 points; both P<0.001). Among the participants with obstructive sleep apnea, the corresponding changes in events per hour in the retatrutide groups for the hybrid-treatment estimand were -22.9, -34.3, and -31.7 versus -9.9 (differences, -24.4 and -21.9; both P<0.001); the corresponding changes for the ITT estimand were -22.8, -34.3, and -32.1 versus -9.6 (differences, -24.7 and -22.5; both P<0.001). The most common adverse events were gastrointestinal.
abstract.textZh: 共有2339名參與者接受了隨機分組。 Retatrutide組的平均體重變化百分比為-17.6% (4-mg劑量)、-23.7% (9-mg劑量)和-25.0% (12-mg劑量) ，而安慰劑組為-3.9% (差異分別為-19.8和-21.0個百分點；兩項比較的P < 0.001)。 在患有膝關節骨性關節炎的參與者中，混合估計數的retatrutide組疼痛評分的相應變化為-3.2、-3.5和-3.6 ，而安慰劑組為-1.9 （差異， -1.6和-1.8分； P < 0.001 ） ； ITT估計數的相應變化為-3.4、-3.9和-4.1 ，而安慰劑組為-2.5 （差異， -1.4和-1.6分； P < 0.001 ）。 在阻塞性睡眠呼吸暫停的參與者中，混合治療估計數字的retatrutide組中每小時事件的相應變化為-22.9、-34.3和-31.7對比-9.9 （差異， -24.4和-21.9 ；兩者P < 0.001 ） ； ITT估計數字的相應變化為-22.8、-34.3和-32.1對比-9.6 （差異， -24.7和-22.5 ；兩者P < 0.001 ）。 最常見的不良事件是胃腸道。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In adults with obesity, retatrutide resulted in significant weight reduction, reduced pain in participants with knee osteoarthritis, and reduced apnea-hypopnea events in participants with obstructive sleep apnea. (Funded by Eli Lilly; TRIUMPH-1 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05929066.).
abstract.textZh: 在肥胖的成年人中， retatrutide顯著減輕了體重，減輕了膝關節骨性關節炎參與者的疼痛，並減少了阻塞性睡眠呼吸暫停參與者的呼吸暫停低通氣事件。（由禮來資助； TRIUMPH-1 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05929066。）

articles.title: Targeted Use of Computed Tomographic Coronary Angiography in Acute Chest Pain
articles.authors: Lee KK, Wereski R, Lowe D, O'Brien R, Ferry AV, Bularga A, Lowry MTH, Taggart C, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Many patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome in whom myocardial infarction has been ruled out in the emergency department remain at risk for cardiovascular events. Whether further investigation reduces this risk is unknown.
abstract.textZh: 許多疑似急性冠狀動脈綜合徵患者的心肌梗塞在急診科已被排除，仍有心血管事件的風險。進一步調查是否能降低這種風險尚不清楚。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a multicenter, randomized, controlled trial, patients who presented to an emergency department in 14 hospitals across the United Kingdom were enrolled if myocardial infarction had been ruled out and high-sensitivity cardiac troponin testing indicated an intermediate risk of a cardiovascular event (maximum high-sensitivity cardiac troponin I or T concentration, >5 ng per liter). Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive either outpatient computed tomographic (CT) coronary angiography-guided care or standard care. The primary outcome was a composite of myocardial infarction or death from a cardiac cause.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Atherosclerosis may begin in early adulthood and remain clinically silent for decades before cardiovascular disease manifests. Although silent atherosclerosis is associated with cardiovascular events and death independent of traditional cardiovascular disease risk factors, its age- and sex-specific prevalence, vascular territory distribution, and plaque volume across adult life remain incompletely defined.
abstract.textZh: 動脈粥樣硬化可能會在成年早期開始，並在心血管疾病出現之前幾十年內保持臨牀沉默。儘管無聲動脈粥樣硬化與心血管事件和死亡有關，與傳統的心血管疾病風險因素無關，但其年齡和性別特異性患病率、血管區域分佈和成人生活中的斑塊體積仍然不完全定義。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a prospective cohort study in Denmark and Spain. Adults 18 to 70 years of age without known atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease were enrolled in five prespecified age strata that included balanced numbers of women and men. Silent atherosclerosis was assessed at baseline with three-dimensional vascular ultrasonography of the carotid and femoral arteries and with coronary computed tomographic angiography.
abstract.textZh: 我們在丹麥和西班牙進行了一項前瞻性隊列研究。未知動脈粥樣硬化性心血管疾病的18至70歲的成年人被納入五個預先指定的年齡層，其中包括均衡的女性和男性人數。基線時使用頸動脈和股動脈的三維血管超聲以及冠狀動脈電腦斷層掃描血管造影評估無聲動脈粥樣硬化。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 16,808 adults were enrolled in the study. The mean (±SD) age of the participants was 45±12 years, and 51.4% were women. Silent atherosclerosis was present in 57.1% of the participants (95% confidence interval, 56.3 to 58.0). In the youngest age stratum (18 to 29 years), atherosclerosis was present in 8.7% of the men and 6.7% of the women; prevalence increased with age, with a later, steeper midlife rise among women. Among participants in the younger age strata, atherosclerosis was most often peripheral and confined to a single vascular territory; with increasing age, plaque volume increased exponentially and the prevalence of multiarterial involvement became more frequent. Isolated coronary-artery atherosclerosis was uncommon in every age stratum (≤9.3% of men and ≤5.0% of women).

articles.title: Eating disorders
articles.authors: Schmidt U, Austin A, Ehrlich S, Robinson P, Wade TD

abstract.text: The eating and feeding disorders are serious psychiatric disorders at the mind-body interface, often with an exceptionally high burden for affected individuals, their families and supporters, and wider society. In anorexia nervosa, high acute medical risk and patients' ambivalence about treatment can make a challenging combination that can impede engagement. First-line treatments for eating disorders are mainly psychological, with medications playing an adjunctive role. Novel biological and technology-based interventions are only slowly emerging. Compared with other psychiatric disorders, research into these disorders is seriously underfunded. Many uncertainties regarding their aetiology, maintenance, and treatment remain. Controversies mainly concern the treatment and care of those with the most severe and longstanding forms of illness. Advances in knowledge are most likely to arise from longitudinal studies combining multimodal assessments, using big data to develop better mechanistic understanding, and greater use of flexible trial designs to allow development of more personalised and precise interventions.
abstract.textZh: 飲食和餵食障礙是身心界面的嚴重精神疾病，通常對受影響的個體、其家人和支持者以及更廣泛的社會造成特別高的負擔。 在神經性厭食症中，高急性醫療風險和患者對治療的矛盾心理可能會形成一種具有挑戰性的組合，這可能會妨礙參與。 飲食失調的一線治療主要是心理治療，藥物起著輔助作用。 新穎的生物和基於技術的幹預措施只是在緩慢地出現。 與其他精神疾病相比，這些疾病的研究資金嚴重不足。 其病因、維持和治療方面仍存在許多不確定性。 爭議主要涉及對患有最嚴重和長期疾病的人的治療和護理。 知識的進步最有可能來自結合多模式評估的縱向研究，使用大數據來發展更好的機械理解，以及更多地使用靈活的試驗設計來開發更個性化和精確的幹預措施。

articles.title: Retinoblastoma
articles.authors: Toumasis PN, Chantada GL, Corson TW, de Graaf P, Gerrish A, Kaliki S, Mallipatna AC, Njambi L, et al.

abstract.text: Retinoblastoma, the most common primary intraocular malignancy of childhood, represents a substantial global health equity concern, exemplifying profound disparities in global burden and outcome despite being a largely curable cancer. Retinoblastoma is thought to arise from cone photoreceptor precursor cells of the developing retina, mainly driven by biallelic inactivation of the RB1 tumour suppressor gene. Fewer than 2% of cases have no detectable RB1 pathogenic variant; approximately half of these cases instead show high-level amplification of the MYCN oncogene. Diagnosis and monitoring currently rely on clinical examination and multimodal imaging. Emerging molecular diagnostic approaches such as aqueous humour liquid biopsy hold promise for minimally invasive tumour characterisation and real-time disease monitoring. Management has shifted towards eye-preserving strategies, with intra-arterial, intravitreal, and intracameral chemotherapy showing efficacy and safety. The global burden and mortality of retinoblastoma remains highest in regions with a low sociodemographic index, highlighting the need for continued interdisciplinary, equity-focused efforts to ensure timely diagnosis and accessible, high-quality care worldwide. This Seminar reviews the advances in retinoblastoma biology, diagnosis, treatment, survivorship, and global efforts to reduce inequities.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The comparative effectiveness of conservative kidney management and dialysis in older people (aged ≥80 years regardless of frailty and comorbidity or aged 65-79 years if frailty or multimorbidity are present) living with kidney failure is unknown. We aimed to assess the relative effectiveness of preparing for responsive management-a protocolised version of conservative kidney management-and preparing for renal dialysis.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: Prepare for Kidney Care was a two-arm, superiority, parallel-group, open-label, pragmatic, phase 3, individually randomised controlled trial conducted in 31 kidney centres in England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland. Eligible patients had an estimated glomerular filtration rate below 15 mL/min per 1·73 m2, confirmed by at least one additional reading in the 12 months preceding consent that was not due to acute kidney injury, and were either aged 80 years or older, or aged 65-79 years with a WHO performance status of at least 3 or a Davies comorbidity score of at least 2. Eligible participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to prepare for responsive management-a patient-centred approach focused on slowing disease progression, active symptom management, and preserving quality of life without the use of dialysis or kidney transplantation-or to prepare for renal dialysis. Randomisation was stratified by centre and minimised by age; a centralised system ensured allocation concealment until randomisation had taken place. The primary outcome was the mean difference in quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs), combining length and health-related quality of life from the patient-reported EQ-5D-5L scale, including all follow-up from randomisation to Aug 31, 2025. The primary outcome was analysed by intention to treat in the full analysis set, which included all randomly assigned participants, with missing EQ-5D-5L values for living participants imputed. Harms (hospital admissions and dialysis access complications) and adverse events (deaths and hospital admissions, by cause) were assessed in the full analysis set. abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: From July 1, 2017, to Aug 31, 2024, 6120 patients were screened across 31 kidney centres in the UK, 445 (7%) of whom were eligible and agreed to be randomly assigned. 228 (51%) of 445 participants were randomly assigned to prepare for responsive management and 217 (49%) of 445 participants were randomly assigned to prepare for renal dialysis. articles.title: Long-term outcomes after percutaneous coronary intervention with drug-eluting stents versus coronary artery bypass grafting for left main coronary artery disease: a prospective analysis of the multicentre IRIS-MAIN registry
articles.authors: Wee SB, Kang DY, Ahn JM, Kim JH, Kim MJ, Rha SW, Her SH, Kim HS, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) with drug-eluting stents has been widely used to treat patients with left main coronary artery disease; however, long-term comparative outcomes versus coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) in real-world populations remain poorly characterised. We aimed to compare long-term all-cause mortality after PCI or CABG in Asian patients with unprotected left main coronary artery disease.
abstract.textZh: 使用藥物洗脫支架進行經皮冠狀動脈介入治療(PCI)已被廣泛用於治療左側主要冠狀動脈疾病的患者；然而，在現實人羣中，與冠狀動脈旁路移植(CABG)相比的長期比較結果仍然表徵不佳。我們旨在比較亞洲無保護左側主要冠狀動脈疾病患者PCI或CABG後的長期全因死亡率。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We analysed prospectively collected data from the multicentre IRIS-MAIN registry, conducted at 46 hospitals in South Korea, India, Japan, Indonesia, and Malaysia. The registry enrolled adults aged 18 years or older with unprotected left main coronary artery disease (defined as a stenosis diameter of ≥50% as visually estimated on angiography), who had been treated with PCI, CABG, or medical therapy alone. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality. We used a target trial emulation framework to compare the long-term risk of all-cause mortality between PCI with drug-eluting stents and isolated CABG. We used propensity-score overlap weighting to adjust for measured baseline covariates. The IRIS-MAIN Registry study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT01341327).
abstract.textZh: 我們分析了在韓國、印度、日本、印尼和馬來西亞的46家醫院進行的多中心IRIS-MAIN註冊表中前瞻性收集的數據。註冊處招募了18歲或以上患有未受保護的左冠狀動脈主動脈疾病（定義為血管造影上視覺估計的狹窄直徑≥ 50 ％ ）的成年人，他們曾接受PCI、CABG或單獨用藥治療。主要結果為全因死亡率。我們使用目標試驗模擬框架來比較使用藥物洗脫支架的PCI和單獨CABG之間的全因死亡率的長期風險。我們使用傾向評分重疊加權來調整測量的基線協變量。IRIS-MAIN Registry研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT01341327 ）注冊。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Jan 1, 2003, and Dec 31, 2024, 6900 patients were enrolled in the IRIS-MAIN registry, of whom 5379 (78·0%) underwent coronary revascularisation through either PCI with drug-eluting stents (3836 [71·3%]) or CABG (1543 [28·7%]) and were included in the analysis. The median duration of follow-up for all patients was 10·0 years (IQR 5·0-16·7). In the overlap-weighted population, no statistically detectable difference in 10-year weighted Kaplan-Meier rates of all-cause mortality was observed between PCI and CABG (24·0% vs 22·9%; overlap-weighted hazard ratio 1·00 [95% CI 0·87-1·14]; p=0·99). The confidence interval does not exclude a mortality benefit or harm with either strategy.
abstract.textZh: 在2003年1月1日至2024年12月31日期間， 6900名患者被納入IRIS-MAIN註冊表，其中5379名（ 78.0 ％ ）通過使用藥物洗滌支架的PCI （ 3836 [71.3 ％] ）或CABG （ 1543 [28.7 ％] ）進行了冠狀動脈血運重建，並被納入分析。所有患者的中位隨訪持續時間為10 · 0年（ IQR 5 · 0-16 · 7 ）。在重疊加權族羣中， PCI和CABG之間未觀察到10年加權Kaplan-Meier全因死亡率的統計可檢測差異（ 24 · 0%對22 · 9% ；重疊加權風險比1 · 00 [95% CI 0 · 87-1 · 14] ； p = 0 · 99 ）。置信區間不排除任何一種策略的死亡率益處或危害。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In this non-randomised registry analysis of patients with left main coronary artery disease, there was no statistically detectable difference in all-cause mortality between PCI and CABG. For patients considered suitable for either strategy, multidisciplinary Heart Team discussion might help patients and clinicians weigh potential trade-offs in the choice between PCI and CABG. These findings are observational and cannot establish causal treatment effects or equivalence in survival.

articles.authors: Hansford HJ, Berg B, Grotle M, Austevoll IM, Dahabreh IJ, Hellum C, Ingebrigtsen T, Jones MD, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Randomized trials have shown limited benefits and increased risks of adding spinal fusion surgery to decompression for degenerative spondylolisthesis. Decompression with fusion has increasingly been used in the United States.
abstract.textZh: 隨機試驗顯示，增加脊柱融合手術以減壓退行性脊柱滑動的益處有限，風險增加。融合減壓在美國越來越多地使用。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To examine the comparative effectiveness of decompression with fusion versus decompression alone for patient subgroups.
abstract.textZh: 檢查融合減壓與單獨減壓對患者次組的比較有效性。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Cohort study using the target trial framework.
abstract.textZh: 使用目標試驗架構的隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Norwegian Registry for Spine Surgery and nested NORDSTEN-DS (Norwegian degenerative spondylolisthesis and spinal stenosis) randomized trial.
abstract.textZh: Norwegian Registry for Spine Surgery和Nested NORDSTEN-DS (Norwegian degenerative spondylolisthesis and spinal stenosis)隨機試驗。

abstract.label: PATIENTS
abstract.text: Adults aged 18 to 80 years with lumbar degenerative spondylolisthesis and symptomatic back or leg pain lasting at least 3 months.
abstract.textZh: 18至80歲的成年人患有腰椎退行性脊柱滑脫症，並出現至少3個月的背部或腿部疼痛症狀。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Lumbar spinal decompression surgery with fusion versus lumbar spinal decompression surgery alone.
abstract.textZh: 融合腰椎減壓手術與單獨的腰椎減壓手術。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: The primary outcomes were Oswestry Disability Index (ODI) score and reoperation at 12 months. Linear regression models with inverse probability weighting to control for baseline confounding were used to obtain effect estimates with 95% CIs for decompression with fusion versus decompression alone for prespecified subgroups, including sex, age, smoking, body mass index (BMI), back pain intensity, and American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) grade.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是Oswestry殘疾指數（ ODI ）評分和12個月時的再手術。對於預先指定的次組，包括性別、年齡、吸煙、身體質量指數(BMI)、背痛強度和美國麻醉師學會(ASA)等級，使用具有反向概率加權以控制基線混雜的線性回歸模型，以95% CI對融合減壓與單獨減壓進行效果估計。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 2252 patients, 236 were in the NORDSTEN-DS randomized trial. The mean age was 66 years, and 1576 (70%) women were included. A total of 1446 patients had decompression alone, and 806 had decompression with fusion; respective unadjusted baseline ODI scores were 38.9 (SD, 14.9) and 41.4 (SD, 14.7). At 12 months, the ODI score was 22.3 (95% CI, 15.5 to 29.1) for decompression alone and 20.0 (CI, 13.9 to 26.2) for decompression with fusion; the mean difference was 2.2 (CI, -1.6 to 6.1). In exploratory analyses, the ODI score was worse for decompression with fusion for men with BMI of 30 kg/m2 or higher. Reoperation risk at 12 months did not differ.

abstract.text: Patient subgroups did not have differential effects from the addition of fusion to decompression at 12 months.

articles.authors: Reeder HT, Donohue SE, Martin JN, Hornig M, Mosier JM, Ashktorab H, Atieh O, Blomkalns AL, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Long COVID (LC) is widespread; however, limited information has been reported on the likelihood that symptoms remit over time.
abstract.textZh: 長期COVID （ LC ）很普遍；但是，關於症狀隨著時間的推移而緩解的可能性，報告的信息有限。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the likelihood of improvement among persons with likely LC.
abstract.textZh: 評估可能患有LC的人改善的可能性。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Prospective, multisite cohort study (RECOVER-Adult [Researching COVID to Enhance Recovery]).
abstract.textZh: 前瞻性、多站點隊列研究(RECOVER-Adult [Researching COVID to Enhance Recovery])。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: 83 U.S.-based sites across 33 states; Washington, DC; and Puerto Rico.
abstract.textZh: 總部位於美國33個州、華盛頓特區和波多黎各的83個網站。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 1019 persons in RECOVER-Adult with likely LC (LC Research Index [LCRI] ≥11) 12 months after first SARS-CoV-2 infection.
abstract.textZh: 在首次SARS-CoV-2感染後12個月，有1019名患者在RECOVER-成人期間可能有LC （ LC研究指數[LCRI] ≥ 11 ）。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: The primary outcome was time until 2 consecutive study visits with LCRI less than 11. Secondary outcomes were time until LCRI measure reduced 50% or more and quality of life was good or better, and LCRI decreased to 0. Unadjusted estimates of cumulative incidence and adjusted marginal cumulative incidence by age, sex, SARS-CoV-2 wave, and LC subtype were reported across all follow-up time points.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: An estimated 36.2% (95% CI, 33.0% to 39.5%) met the primary outcome by 24 months after infection, and 50.1% (CI, 46.1% to 54.0%) met the primary outcome by 36 months. An estimated 56.4% (CI, 52.2% to 60.4%) and 26.9% (CI, 23.3% to 30.5%), respectively, met the 2 secondary outcomes by 36 months. Among persons who still reported likely LC at 18 months and 24 months after first infection, relative timing of subsequent symptom improvement was similar.
